bank_rule: One final-collector bank per training seed; shared across checkpoints/objectives/horizons within seed. Different seeds have different banks and collectors.
statistics: Equal weight per independent training seed; sample SD. A missing or undefined seed metric leaves cohort mean/SD unavailable and reports the defined-seed count. Never pool states or directions as independent training seeds.
associations: Descriptive Pearson correlations across WM stages within each training seed; no p-values, causal inference or pooled stage independence.
costs: Probe campaign allocations are separately charged; they do not alter training-method efficiency curves. Fresh resource preflight and bounded budgets required before probes.
limitations: Action-sequence gradients, nominal simulator parameters, no critic in the probe objective. Finite differences are numerical references.
Per-seed bank distribution changes with the final collector; this is not a shared-state causal test of training seeds.
Microstep comparisons use states with reproducible starts for the gradient and all random directions at the same epsilon; FD resolution is reported separately.
H32 stable-contact coverage may be sparse or absent; retain counts and undefined metrics.
Prediction errors use only the declared canonical probe; six replayed probes are not six independent prediction datasets.
reset_protocol: native physical state restore, nominal xi, Newton solver reset flags=0 before each rollout
resource_basis: Development six-probe campaign measured 0.188922389686 GPU-hours; 25% reserve is 0.236153 per seed. These caps do not replace each-launch resource checks.
